<div class="card-body">
'''Portable Fusion Generator''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] ([[Item]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">携帯用融合ジェネレーター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の戦士に配備する。その戦士がブラスター・ライフルか固定兵器を起動する場合、武器運命数にそれぞれ1を加える。さらに、同じ場所にいるドロイド1体の戦闘力に1を加えることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Portable-Fusion-Generator-PSA-92654371.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">大型の強襲用兵器を使用する際には、兵員自身が動力源を持ち歩かなければならない。この装置は軽量かつ高性能で、戦闘時に必要とされる動力を十分に供給してくれる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Portable Fusion Generator.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any warrior. When that warrior activates a blaster rifle or artillery weapon, add 1 to each weapon destiny. Also, may add 1 to the power of one droid at the same place.

'''Lore:'''
When using large assault weapons, troops must carry their own power sources. This unit is light and high-performance, and supplies ample power for combat.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese prints アイテム where English prints Device.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Portable Fusion Generator]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
